#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    string text;
    getline(cin, text);
    // Replace 'dot' with '.' in the middle of the string
    size_t start_pos = 1; // start from second character
    size_t end_pos = text.size() - 1; // last character index
    string middle = text.substr(start_pos, end_pos - start_pos);
    size_t pos;
    while ((pos = middle.find("dot")) != string::npos) {
        middle.replace(pos, 3, ".");
    }
    // Replace 'at' with '@' once in the middle
    size_t at_pos = middle.find("at");
    if (at_pos != string::npos) {
        middle.replace(at_pos, 2, "@");
    }
    // Reconstruct the text
    string result = text[0] + middle + text.back();
    cout << result << "\n";

    return 0;
}
